title: Early Tamil Pottery AI - Image Record
description: One record per PHOTOGRAPH of a pottery sherd. Multiple records may share an artifact_id when several photographs document the same physical object. artifact_id is the train/val/test split key (see docs/SPLIT_METHODOLOGY.md). Missing information MUST be marked with an explicit sentinel ('unknown', 'not_available', 'not_applicable') and MUST NOT be invented.

free_text.description: Free text, or one of the sentinels 'unknown' / 'not_available' / 'not_applicable'. Empty string is NOT permitted - absence must be explicit.

signed_year.description: Year as a signed integer. Negative = BCE, positive = CE. There is no year 0 (use -1 for 1 BCE, 1 for 1 CE). null means the bound is not established.

region.description: An annotated region of interest in the image. Coordinate system is 'xywh_pixels': x,y are the top-left corner in absolute pixels measured from the image top-left; w,h are width and height in pixels; measured in the ORIGINAL unrotated image as stored in data/raw.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written against.

image_id.description: Globally unique identifier for THIS PHOTOGRAPH. Convention: artifactid__view[__n]. Must be unique across the whole dataset.

artifact_id.description: Identifier of the PHYSICAL OBJECT. All photographs of the same sherd MUST share this value. THIS IS THE TRAIN/VAL/TEST SPLIT KEY - see docs/SPLIT_METHODOLOGY.md. If it is not known whether two photographs show the same object, they must be treated as the same artifact (conservative grouping) and flagged in notes.

image_path.description: Path to the image file, relative to data/raw/. Forward slashes only.

image_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the image file bytes. Used to detect the same photograph entering the dataset twice under different ids - a direct data-leakage vector.

view.description: Which aspect of the sherd the photograph shows.

scale_bar_present.description: Whether a physical scale/measuring reference is visible. Determines whether absolute size features may be used.

source.description: Kind of origin the image came from.

source_reference.description: Precise pointer into the source: report page/plate/figure number, museum record, repository URL, etc. Must be specific enough for a third party to locate the original.

catalogue_reference.description: Accession / catalogue / corpus number as printed in the source. NEVER invent a catalogue number.

license.description: Licence or rights status of the image, verbatim where known. Recommended values: an SPDX id (e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0'), 'public_domain', 'permission_granted_see_rights_notes', 'rights_reserved_no_redistribution', 'permission_pending', 'unknown'.

redistributable.description: Whether this image may be redistributed with the dataset. 'unknown' means it MUST NOT be redistributed until clarified.

research_usable.description: Added in schema 1.1.0 (Milestone 5). Whether the rights holder has permitted, or it has otherwise been affirmatively established, that this image may be used to train and evaluate this project's models. Separate from redistributable and commercially_usable: permission to train is not permission to republish. 'unknown' (and absence of the field) is treated as 'no' by the training readiness gate. See docs/DATA_SOURCE_AUDIT.md §0.3.

commercially_usable.description: Added in schema 1.1.0 (Milestone 5). Whether the image may be used commercially. Recorded for completeness; the research prototype does not require it. 'unknown' is treated as 'no'.

site.description: Archaeological site name as published. NEVER invent a site.

excavation_reference.description: Excavation season / trench / quadrant identifier as published.

stratigraphic_context.description: Layer / depth / phase as published, verbatim.

context_reliability.description: How securely the object is tied to an archaeological context. Constrains how much weight stratigraphic evidence may carry in chronological reasoning.

pottery_type.description: Ware category as published. Do not assign a value unless the source states it or an expert annotator determines it.

inscription_present.description: Whether any deliberate mark (script or graffiti) is present on the sherd. 'uncertain' = an annotator examined it and cannot tell. 'unknown' (schema 1.2.0) = not yet examined by any annotator, e.g. an acquired public image awaiting expert review.

script_type.description: PRIMARY CLASSIFICATION LABEL (Milestone 4). 'tamil_brahmi' = Tamil-Brahmi / Tamili script. 'graffiti' = non-script or undeciphered incised marks. 'none' = no visible deliberate mark. 'uncertain' = a mark is present but cannot be assigned. 'tamil_brahmi_and_graffiti' = both co-occur on the same sherd. 'other_script' = a different script (e.g. Prakrit-Brahmi, Vatteluttu, Grantha); such records are HELD OUT of the initial 4-class classifier. 'unknown' (schema 1.2.0) = no label has been assigned yet, as for acquired public images awaiting expert annotation; HELD OUT, never trained on, and never inferred by the project or by a model.

label_source.description: WHO assigned script_type. Determines whether the label may be treated as ground truth.

inscription_regions.description: Zero or more annotated regions. Supplies supervision for Milestone 6 (inscription-region detection). An empty array means 'no regions annotated yet', NOT 'no inscription' - that is what inscription_present records.

character_count_visible.description: Number of distinct characters/marks visible, if counted. null = not counted.

transcription.description: Transcription of the inscription AS PUBLISHED, or as read by an expert annotator. NEVER fill in characters that are not visible. Preserve the source's editorial conventions for damage and restoration.

reading_status.description: Epistemic status of the reading. Records marked 'disputed' or 'published_tentative' MUST NOT be presented by the prototype as settled readings.

alternative_readings.description: Other readings proposed in the literature. Each entry should carry its own attribution inline, e.g. 'reading (Author Year)'.

reading_source.description: Who produced the transcription/translation recorded above, with citation.

dating_text.description: Date as stated in the source, VERBATIM (e.g. 'c. 2nd century BCE'). This is the primary record; the numeric bounds below are a derived machine-readable convenience.

dating_basis.description: On what grounds the date rests. Multiple values allowed. An empty array is not permitted - use ['unknown'].

dating_reliability.description: 'disputed' marks dates actively contested in the literature. Such records must never be used as unqualified training targets or presented as settled.

dating_source.description: Citation for the date. Required in practice whenever a numeric bound is given.

publication.description: Full bibliographic reference. NEVER invent a publication.

split.description: Assigned in Milestone 2 by artifact_id, never by image. 'excluded' records are retained for the record but used nowhere.

verification_status.description: Whether a human has checked this record against its cited source. Records that are not 'verified_against_source' MUST NOT support any claim the prototype presents to a user as evidence.
